name: SimpleGraph.sum_adj
initialProofState:
α : Type u_1
β : Type u_2
G : SimpleGraph α
H : SimpleGraph β
u v : Sum α β
⊢ Eq ((G.sum H).Adj u v) (SimpleGraph.sum.match_1 (fun u v => Prop) u v (fun u v => G.Adj u v) (fun u v => H.Adj u v) fun x x => False)
decl:
/-- Disjoint sum of `G` and `H`. -/
@[simps!]
protected def sum (G : SimpleGraph α) (H : SimpleGraph β) : SimpleGraph (α ⊕ β) where
  Adj u v := match u, v with
    | Sum.inl u, Sum.inl v => G.Adj u v
    | Sum.inr u, Sum.inr v => H.Adj u v
    | _, _ => false
  symm u v := match u, v with
    | Sum.inl u, Sum.inl v => G.adj_symm
    | Sum.inr u, Sum.inr v => H.adj_symm
    | Sum.inl _, Sum.inr _ | Sum.inr _, Sum.inl _ => id
  loopless u := by cases u <;> simp

name: SimpleGraph.Iso.sumComm_symm_apply
initialProofState:
α : Type u_1
β : Type u_2
G : SimpleGraph α
H : SimpleGraph β
a✝ : Sum β α
⊢ Eq ((RelIso.symm SimpleGraph.Iso.sumComm) a✝) a✝.swap
decl:
/-- The disjoint sum is commutative up to isomorphism. `Iso.sumComm` as a graph isomorphism. -/
@[simps!]
def Iso.sumComm : G ⊕g H ≃g H ⊕g G := ⟨Equiv.sumComm α β, by
  intro u v
  cases u <;> cases v <;> simp⟩

name: SimpleGraph.Iso.sumAssoc_apply
initialProofState:
α : Type u_1
β : Type u_2
γ : Type u_3
G : SimpleGraph α
H : SimpleGraph β
I : SimpleGraph γ
a✝ : Sum (Sum α β) γ
⊢ Eq (SimpleGraph.Iso.sumAssoc a✝) (Sum.elim (Sum.elim Sum.inl (Function.comp Sum.inr Sum.inl)) (Function.comp Sum.inr Sum.inr) a✝)
decl:
/-- The disjoint sum is associative up to isomorphism. `Iso.sumAssoc` as a graph isomorphism. -/
@[simps!]
def Iso.sumAssoc {I : SimpleGraph γ} : (G ⊕g H) ⊕g I ≃g G ⊕g (H ⊕g I) := ⟨Equiv.sumAssoc α β γ, by
  intro u v
  cases u <;> cases v <;> rename_i u v
  · cases u <;> cases v <;> simp
  · cases u <;> simp
  · cases v <;> simp
  · simp⟩

name: SimpleGraph.Embedding.sumInl_apply
initialProofState:
α : Type u_1
β : Type u_2
G : SimpleGraph α
H : SimpleGraph β
u : α
⊢ Eq (SimpleGraph.Embedding.sumInl u) (Sum.inl u)
decl:
/-- The embedding of `G` into `G ⊕g H`. -/
@[simps]
def Embedding.sumInl : G ↪g G ⊕g H where
  toFun u := _root_.Sum.inl u
  inj' u v := by simp
  map_rel_iff' := by simp
